description: Next Capital Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 14 December 2009 and has been listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange since 2012. It is engaged in the brokerage of shares, stocks, equity and debt securities, commodities, forex and other financial instruments, and in corporate finance and investment banking advisory, and it also trades equity and debt securities on its own account. It is a TRE certificate holder and a member of the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, Imperial Court Building, Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed Road, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
